name: Opening contract funds the first machine
description: Verify a fresh save starts with no cash or machines and the first contract advances enough Rivets to buy the mine.
steps: Reset to a fresh factory
Verify wallet is 0 RVT and no machine is owned
Accept First Ore Delivery and verify +50 RVT
Build the Rockbreaker Mine for 50 RVT
expected: The player starts at zero, must accept the opening contract, receives a 50 RVT advance and can then build the first mine.

name: First delivery triggers the power-cut story and pays once
description: Verify the opening order consumes the required ore, pays the reward and triggers the illustrated one-time power failure with working recovery choices.
steps: Accept First Ore Delivery and build the Rockbreaker Mine
Produce five ore and deliver the order
Verify 85 RVT and five reputation are awarded and the power-cut comic appears
Choose the one-off repair for 40 RVT
Refresh and verify the power-cut incident does not replay
expected: The order pays once, consumes five ore, grants the stated reward, opens the power-cut storyboard, stops production and resumes after repair.

name: Save and reload retains campaign incidents and contracts
description: Verify contract and incident flags survive a refresh without duplicating an advance, reward or cutscene.
steps: Accept the opening contract
Refresh and verify the advance is not paid again
Complete the order and resolve the power cut
Refresh the game
Verify the order remains fulfilled and the power-cut story does not replay
expected: Accepted and completed contract states and resolved one-time incidents persist after reload.

name: Breakdown cutscene stops the line and offers recovery
description: Verify a machine failure opens a persistent incident overlay, pauses production and provides a safe repair or defer path.
steps: Start a factory with at least one machine running
Wait for a random machine failure
Verify the incident overlay names the affected machine and the line stops
Use an assigned mechanic or spend 40 RVT for emergency repair
Verify the overlay closes and production resumes
expected: A breakdown opens one incident at a time, halts all production while active, persists through refresh, and can be repaired with an assigned mechanic or 40 RVT; the player can defer repair without becoming stuck.

name: Mech Assembly unlock triggers the cyberattack cutscene
covers: cybersecurity specialist hire and permanent protection
description: Verify commissioning Mech Assembly triggers the illustrated network breach, halts production and lets the player hire security or buy an external recovery.
steps: Progress through the early production chain until Mech Assembly can be built
Keep at least 350 RVT available and build Mech Assembly
Verify the cyberattack storyboard appears and production is locked
Hire the cybersecurity specialist
Refresh and verify the incident does not replay and the specialist remains on staff
expected: The first Mech Assembly purchase triggers one cyberattack cutscene, halts production, hires a persistent specialist who secures the network, and never replays after reload.
